text: Entry Requirements a. Any applicant shall hold a non-Chinese citizen valid passport and have good moral behavior, abide by the law and regulations of the People's Republic of China, without any criminal record. Those applicants who recently changed for a foreign nationality, please pay special attention: According to Foreign Language Education Official Regulation No. 83 (2009), since 2010, any overseas applicant shall hold a foreign country valid passport or certificate of his/her citizenship for 4 years or more; or he/she shall have been living overseas for 2 years or more (before be admitted on April 30th of the relevant academic year). Note: Nine months of actual overseas living may be calculated as one year according to the singing for entry and exit. b. Any applicant shall have an equal degree of a bachelor in China, fresh or a former one. Anyone who has a master degree or doctoral degree majoring in the specialty associated with the film art will be preferred. c. The applicant shall be moral and abide by the laws and regulations of the People's Republic of China without any criminal records; he or she shall be healthy according to the requirements, national or at the university level. Note: If you don't have HSK level certificate you need to study two-year pre-university program to learn Chinese.
